title: A class of chemical compounds enhances clustering of muscle nicotinic acetylcholine receptor in cultured myogenic cells.
authors: Miyairi, Yuichi; Ohkawara, Bisei; Sato, Ayato; Sawada, Ryusuke; Ishii, Hisao; Tomita, Hiroyuki; Inoue, Taro; Nakashima, Hiroaki; Ito, Mikako; Masuda, Akio; Hosono, Yasuyuki; Imagama, Shiro; Ohno, Kinji
one_liner_zh: 该文筛选增强乙酰胆碱受体聚集的化合物，虽含分子对接模拟，但核心是药物筛选与细胞表型，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题关系微弱。
abstract: Neuromuscular signal transmission is affected in various diseases including myasthenia gravis, congenital myasthenic syndromes, and sarcopenia. We used an ATF2-luciferase system to monitor the phosphorylation of MuSK in HEK293 cells introduced with MUSK and LRP4 cDNAs to find novel chemical compounds that enhanced agrin-mediated acetylcholine receptor (AChR) clustering. Four compounds with similar chemical structures carrying benzene rings and heterocyclic rings increased the luciferase activities 8- to 30-folds, and two of them showed continuously graded dose dependence. The effects were higher than that of disulfiram, a clinically available aldehyde dehydrogenase inhibitor, which we identified to be the most competent preapproved drug to enhance ATF2-luciferase activity in the same assay system. In C2C12 myotubes, all the compounds increased the area, intensity, length, and number of AChR clusters. Three of the four compounds increased the phosphorylation of MuSK, but not of Dok7, JNK. ERK, or p38. Monitoring cell toxicity using the neurite elongation of NSC34 neuronal cells as a surrogate marker showed that all the compounds had no effects on the neurite elongation up to 1 muM. Extensive docking simulation and binding structure prediction of the four compounds with all available human proteins using AutoDock Vina and DiffDock showed that the four compounds were unlikely to directly bind to MuSK or Dok7, and the exact target remained unknown. The identified compounds are expected to serve as a seed to develop a novel therapeutic agent to treat defective NMJ signal transmission.
abstract_zh: 神经肌肉信号传递在多种疾病中受到影响，包括重症肌无力 (myasthenia gravis)、先天性肌无力综合征 (congenital myasthenic syndromes) 和肌少症 (sarcopenia)。我们使用ATF2-荧光素酶系统监测引入MUSK和LRP4 cDNA的HEK293细胞中MuSK的磷酸化，以寻找增强agrin介导的乙酰胆碱受体 (acetylcholine receptor, AChR) 聚集的新型化学化合物。四种具有相似化学结构、携带苯环和杂环的化合物将荧光素酶活性提高了8至30倍，其中两种显示出连续分级的剂量依赖性。其效果高于双硫仑 (disulfiram)，一种临床可用的醛脱氢酶抑制剂，我们在同一测定系统中将其鉴定为增强ATF2-荧光素酶活性的最有效预批准药物。在C2C12肌管中，所有化合物均增加了AChR聚集的面积、强度、长度和数量。四种化合物中的三种增加了MuSK的磷酸化，但不增加Dok7、JNK、ERK或p38的磷酸化。使用NSC34神经元细胞的神经突延伸作为替代标志物监测细胞毒性，结果显示所有化合物在高达1 μM浓度下对神经突延伸无影响。使用AutoDock Vina和DiffDock对四种化合物与所有可用人类蛋白质进行广泛对接模拟和结合结构预测，结果表明这四种化合物不太可能直接结合MuSK或Dok7，确切靶点仍未知。所鉴定的化合物有望作为开发新型治疗药物以治疗NMJ信号传递缺陷的种子。
